purpose: Prevent the baseline objective from being closed or project-owned models from being cleaned after WMA alone. The two remaining directly comparable tracks must produce fresh local evidence under their own matched protocols.

eligible_inputs: official source and immutable revision availability
control coverage required by the frozen evidence policy
prohibited_inputs: favorable or unfavorable local comparator values

global_entry_gate: The WMA v3 sequence must be terminal-accepted through effective phases 1-5, with all accepted and rejected evidence archived. WMA completion is a prerequisite, not completion of the overall baseline objective.

identity_exclusions.omnimem-agent: Deprecated alias; it must not create a second numeric entity beside the canonical Omni-SimpleMem WMA run.
identity_exclusions.agentenhance-ceu: Proposed method remains locked until at least two recent baselines on this track are locally accepted.

matched_protocol.answer_backbone: one exact frozen local model and revision shared by every method and later AgentEnhance run
matched_protocol.evaluator: one exact frozen local evaluator, prompt, decoding configuration and implementation
matched_protocol.failure_denominator_rule: observed plus failed equals 1711; empty answers and per-question exceptions remain failures in the denominator
matched_protocol.retrieval_budget: K=10 or a prospectively frozen token-equivalent budget reported alongside K
matched_protocol.seed_rule: seeds 0,1,2 for stochastic methods; one run only after a separate byte-determinism audit

required_stage_order: freeze exact dataset, qid order, source revisions, model revisions, environment locks and resource ceilings
materialize and audit sources, data and project-owned models without numerical execution
run method-specific lifecycle or integration smoke in fresh roots and retain every failure
freeze method-specific numerical authorization before reading a complete method score
execute every registered method and control without score-based dropping
reconcile all 1711 qids, metrics, failures and seeds, then archive raw and projected evidence
tracks.exit_gate: All seven recent methods and seven controls have accepted complete local summaries, or an immutable terminal technical blocker recorded after the frozen attempt. No official value fills a missing cell.

tracks.development_evidence_boundary: cmi-r2-deterministic-full-recovery1 is retained as development evidence only. Its deterministic answer fallback and zero selected memories cannot populate main-comparison cells.

matched_protocol.answer_backbone: one exact frozen local model and revision shared by all seven methods and later AgentEnhance
matched_protocol.failure_denominator_rule: all registered example-method pairs remain in the denominator
matched_protocol.seed_rule: seeds 0,1,2 unless a separate complete-run byte-determinism audit authorizes one run

required_stage_order: freeze the local answer-model adapter, evaluator, dataset identity, method identities and resource ceilings
accept a real-model lifecycle and denominator smoke without reusing development outputs
freeze numerical authorization before any complete real-model score is observed
execute, reconcile and archive every method under the same protocol
tracks.exit_gate: All seven local real-model method results and their complete evidence archive are accepted, or terminal failures remain visible without source-reported replacement.

different_domain_boundary: M3-Agent, MM-Mem and MMA remain recorded on their own benchmarks. Their values cannot be merged into or ranked against WMA, Mem-Gallery or Causal-LoCoMo cells.
cleanup_gate: No project-owned model may become DRY_RUN_ELIGIBLE until every dependent method across WMA, Mem-Gallery and Causal-LoCoMo is terminal, all accepted and failed evidence is archived and verified, and the frozen ownership ledger proves that no pending track still references the model.
explicitly_prohibited: declaring the overall baseline objective complete after WMA alone
copying source-reported or development-only values into local main-comparison cells
dropping a method, seed, qid, example, metric or failure after observing its score
running AgentEnhance on a track before the evidence policy's recent-baseline gate is met
cleaning a model while any dependent cross-track reproduction remains pending
claiming SOTA from incomparable tracks or incomplete local evidence
